title: How someone speaks is not all they are
principle: Use communication tendencies as a lens. Desire, fear, context and personal history must create variation.
extension: Give every fictional character multiple voice samples, a desire and a contradiction.

title: One event, two interpretations
principle: A remembered encounter can change trust without being understood the same way by both people.
source: content/npc_templates.yaml: relationship metrics, metric_updates and state_rules; dynamic memory described by team
extension: Record a shared event and a separate interpretation at each end of an edge. No runtime memory simulator is copied.

title: A scene begins with a want
principle: A seed should contain a situation, stakes and a character goal, not an arbitrary line of dialogue.
source: content/scenario_seeds.yaml: context.premise, stakes, npc_goal and possible_outcomes
extension: Each story hook references an approved edge and its breaking point.

title: Connection contains possible change
principle: An alliance can hold an incompatible need; tension is not limited to hostility.
source: content/npc_templates.yaml: paired metrics and changing states
extension: Every edge records what each person wants, what keeps them together and what could break the pattern.
